---
format: headerletter-typst          # or, to keep the intermediate .typ file:
#  headerletter-typst:
#    keep-typ: true

# ---- Letter metadata ----
date: last-modified                 # or "June 21, 2026", today, etc.; omit for today's date
date-format: long                   # default: long (e.g., October 12, 2026)
subject: "A Letter"                 # shown centred as "Subject: ..." and in the footer
recipient: "XXX"                    # greeting: "Dear XXX,"; omit to write your own greeting
recipient-address: |                # optional address block above the subject; omit if not needed
  Name \
  Department, Institution \
  City, Province, Postal Code

# ---- Sender (defaults shown) ----
sender-name: "Longhai Li"
sender-title: "Professor of Statistics"

# ---- Images (defaults shown) ----
header-image: usaskdepthead.png     # letterhead image
signature-image: lhsigblk.png       # or lhsigblue.png
# image-dir: "/images"              # optional: folder of your own images, relative to the
                                    # project root (leading "/"); default is the extension's images/
---

Body of the letter.
